# Register and manage projects `RMP`

[As built](../README.md) › Register and manage projects

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Lets a user add a repository to Fabrika as a project, remove it, and adjust its scaffolding and Dockerfile placement so the system can build against it, via export:create_project and the project routes.
